newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lai Sun to raise US$98 mln from bonds.
newsitem.headline: Lai Sun to raise US$98 mln from bonds.

text.p: Lai Sun Development Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would raise net proceeds of about US$97.5 million from the issue of US$100 million worth of bonds convertible into shares of its Asia Television Ltd (ATV) unit.

The company said in a statement that the net proceeds would be increased to US$112.1 million if the lead managers of the bond issue exercise in full their option to subscribe to a further US$15 million in bonds.
Proceeds will be used to replenish Lai Sun Development's land bank in Hong Kong and for general working capital, it said.
The 5.0 percent exchangeable bonds are due in 2004.
Lai Sun Development said it intended to launch an initial public offering of ATV shares on or before June 1, 2001.

The company has held a 16.67 percent of Asia Television since 1988. In the event of an initial public offering of ATV shares, bond holders would be able to exchange the bonds for the ATV shares held by the Lai Sun Development group, it said.
Lai Sun Development chairman Lim Por Yen and deputy chairman Peter Lam Kin Ngok own about 50.83 percent of the shares of Asia Television.
